title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated Nucleated Blood Nanobind
author: Pacific Biosciences
materials: Thermo Fisher KingFisher™ 1 mL 96-well deep-well plate
In one Thermo Fisher KingFisher™ 1 mL 96-well deep-well plate, labelled Lysis Plate, add the following reagents into each well for the number of samples being processed:

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the Lysis Plate by adding the following reagents to each sample well:

substeps.instruction: Add 5 to 10 μL of nucleated blood
Add 150 μL of Buffer BL3 gently against the side of the well

steps.title: Set up KingFisher Plates
steps.instruction: Set up six Thermo Fisher KingFisher™ 1 mL 96-well deep-well plates, ensuring reagents correspond to the sample wells in the Lysis Plate:

substeps.instruction: Nanobind Disc Storage Plate: One 3 mm Nanobind disc per well
Wash Plate 1: 700 µL Buffer CW1 per well
Wash Plate 2: 700 µL Buffer CW2 per well
Wash Plate 3: 700 µL Buffer CW2 per well
Elution Plate: 100 µL Buffer EB per well

steps.title: Initialize KingFisher Apex Instrument
steps.instruction: Select the required DNA extraction protocol from the protocol list on the KingFisher™ Apex and press the play button.

steps.title: Load Plates and Start Run
steps.instruction: Load the filled plates onto the instrument following the on-screen instructions. The protocol will begin automatically and takes approximately 75 minutes.

steps.title: Add Isopropanol During Run
steps.instruction: Approximately 22 minutes into the protocol, when prompted by the instrument, perform the following:

substeps.instruction: Remove the Lysis Plate from the instrument
Gently add 300 μL of isopropanol to each sample well against the side of the well
Re-insert the plate into the instrument

steps.title: Recover Eluates
steps.instruction: Once the protocol is complete, remove the plates following on-screen instructions and transfer eluates from the Elution Plate to microcentrifuge tubes using a standard P200 pipette and 200 μL tips.

steps.title: Homogenize and Solubilize DNA
steps.instruction: Process the eluates to ensure DNA homogeneity and solubility:

substeps.instruction: Pipette mix the eluate 10 times using a standard P200 pipette and 200 μL tip
Incubate eluates at room temperature overnight
Following the overnight rest, pipette mix 10 times using a standard P200 pipette and 200 μL tip

steps.title: Final QC and Storage
steps.instruction: Perform the required quality control (QC) and store the DNA at 4 °C.
